slovakia.title: Flag of the Slovak Republic

colors.note: A pan-Slavic colour representing loyalty and truth.
A pan-Slavic colour representing the bloodshed and courage of the Slovak people.

desc:
- Three equal horizontal bands of white, blue, and red (pan-Slavic colours) with the national coat of arms placed toward the hoist
- The coat of arms shows a white double-cross on three blue hills, on a red shield with a white fimbriation
- Adopted on 3 September 1992 and enshrined in the Constitution when Slovakia separated peacefully from Czechoslovakia in 1993
trivia:
- The double-cross on three hills has been a Slovak symbol since at least the 14th century
- The three hills are traditionally identified as Tatra, Fatra, and Matra
- Without the coat of arms, Slovakia's flag is identical to the flags of Russia and Slovenia in colour pattern
